notes.title: Version 1.3.400 and free DLC
notes.notes:
This version includes our new free DLC called Project Amalthea: Campaign https://store.steampowered.com/app/1496200/Project_Amalthea_Campaign
All DLC owners get access to a new location, where there are several new bases, more than 60 quests, many new loot and bosses, as well as the Assassin class using stealth modules.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1496200/extras/assasin.jpg?t=1608303910[/img]

Changes:
- daily random quests
- +1 talent point with each level or when resetting talents
- reputation quests - random quests can be taken for any values ​​of reputation
- experience for killing mobs
- reworked quest tracking system
- fixed an issue that caused single player tracked quests to apply to all players logging in from that PC
- fixed a bug due to which resistance to different types of damage was always 0
- completely replaced formulas of damage and life of NPC
- the level of opponents in raid battles corresponds to the level of the player
- fixed inability to shoot after using patches and capacitors
- fixed cooldown of artifacts
- separate highlighting the boss and elite enemy
- fixed overflow and spam in chat with too high criminal level
- clouds and chests no longer degrade reputation when killed
- added separation of items when dragging, buying, selling and through the menu with the right button
- for items in the store, the purchase / sale price is written as a percentage of the nominal
- many quests give reputation to NPCs and worsen to pirates and vice versa
- fixed a problem with laser attacks spam for some mobs
- added sign at the Station after the first visit
- items dropped from mobs can be damaged (have a lower selling value)
- fixed a bug due to which damaged items always had a value of 10% of the nominal
- fixed influence of reputation on discounts for selling items
- fixed the presence of high-level items on sale that require reputation
- hulls on sale at new Stations received +100 life and shield
- a starcoin certificate costs 500 credits and is not available for sale
- players who registered through Steam receive 10 starkoins and a third level of account from the start
- up to 25% discount on all purchases of starcoins!
- a large number of other changes

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.notes:
[b]Fellow gamers!
We want to congratulate you with our new major game update.[/b]

Now with version 1.2 we have all new beginning of the game - at the end of the training course player immediately gets into a real battle for 3 or 4 people called «Final Exam» *. It’s a Deathmatch battle where you need to score the most kills to win. But don’t be afraid of losing the exam - we take top 3 pilots from the each group so you will have a chance to improve your skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31530132/b0369247808413b23e8177a8ad4791f3f945aca1.png[/img]

Also the process of enlisting into the new battle was completely redone. The will be no more ** incomprehensible texts and settings, but at full-fledged map graphics instead with few extra details alike  estimated waiting time for the battle.

We also reduced the number of triangles in the frame by 40% which should significantly affect old and integrated GPU performance.

[i]* The Drone Junkyard is still in the game, but it must be created manually.
** You still can access the old mode pressing Advanced button[/i]

[b]Other important changes in version 1.2.382:[/b]
- in the FFA games the best result and the current leader are shown on the right side
- various structures have been added to raid dungeons (don't forget to update the client!)
- removed the shortcut at the beginning of the Sect map
- Sect map is available at level 4 as 2-4 player game
- if game start takes longer than expected it can be started with fewer players
- a random queue does not invites a player if one of the tasks has already been completed there (quest, flag, other score)
- replaced NPC building models
- optimized models for buildings of other factions
- optimized asteroid models
- fixed problems with opponent level display in battle table, incl. level up at the end of the game
- fixed problems with 2x (and sometimes even 0x!) damage from the mobiles in raid dungeons
- damage and kills are correctly counted in dungeons
- various changes in formulas and balance
- fixed some cases of mobs getting stuck in asteroids
- fixed issues where it was impossible to enter the battle even with a sufficient number of players
- the first game launch is now in top-down camera view, not the 3rd person camera (it’s still available in the settings)
- background objects have their color matched with asteroids and environmental lighting
- some compatibility changes for old ATI video cards
- lots of performance optimizations and other fixes

notes.title: 3rd Person camera, new Co-op dungeon, Control theme update
notes.notes:
Fellow pilots!
Here goes one of the first improvements based on your feedbacks and suggestions.

First of all now [b][u]arrow keys and ASWD behave differently[/u][/b]. Arrows move the ship in their direction while ASWD is our usual control theme - acceleration and turns. You can switch the keys in settings.

Secondly we're announcing new game mode. [b][u]Now you can play with 3rd Person camera![/u][/b] You will see the option when starting the game from Steam, or you can choose it in game settings.

Finally there is a [b][u]new Co-op dungeon called The Slums.[/u][/b] It's designed for 2-4 players and 15-20 minutes overall gameplay. Note that dungeon is still in development and have some minor issues.

[b]Other changes Version 1.0.364 to 1.0.365:[/b]
- Sect dungeon moved to level 4
- fixed too long station docking process
- countdown timer changes to red when less than 1 minutes remains
- displaying map minimum and maximum player count in the list
- automatic resurrection for players when leaving the battleground
- better joystick support
- sound feedback when opening the gate, capturing the artifact, taking the flag
- lot of misc changes and improvements

notes.title: Release date
notes.notes:
[b]Great news, everyone![/b]

     Despite all the obstacles and the fact that the game was made by a tiny Indie 5-people team, we are ready to announce Project Amalthea: Battlegrounds [b]release on October 12, 8AM California Time![/b]

     We could tell a lot about our game and the long journey to the release but all we possess an irresistible desire to be honest and follow the best traditions of For-Gamers-By-Gamers communication style.

[i]Attention! There will be a lot of text below and you’re welcome to proceed only if you have the time and mood for it.[/i]




     [b]First of all[/b], we want to confess that the release version is far from perfect both in  technical terms and as for our original vision for this game. But rest assured that we are aimed to make the game better and better with your help and move on with your help. 

     That’s not only a question of minor bugs of typos and inconsistencies in the interface (which we will definitely fix!), but there is a huge list of ideas and features left behind such as more weapon types, cooperative tower defense mode, race mini-game and other features. We also had to put aside a dozen and a half level maps, several game classes, skill branches, hundreds of items, in-game crafting, etc. Although the most parts of the list are already implemented in one way or another, those were not included in the current version of the game for a number of reasons. In fact this list is our roadmap for the near future, and that is what we're definitely going to do with patches and updates.

     That letter is not an awkward attempt to justify ourselves for possible bugs (they always will thrive!) and issues. We want you to know that we’ll be extremely grateful for any kind of game feedback (positive or negative, it doesn’t matter) because every opinion is of great value. We anticipate hearing back from you to understand whether our game is of interest and what should be done to improve it.


     [b]The second point[/b]  - the release does not mean that we’re ceasing the development, of course not! We’re looking forward to the next patches and updates and for you it’s a great opportunity to take part in shaping our project and it’s community. We are ready to make every effort needed for the further development of the project. 

So, we’ll see you in the vicinity of Jupiter! )



Best regards, Project Amalthea Team

notes.title: Weekend changelog
notes.notes:
Hey, pilots!
Last updates:


[b]0.4.319[/b]

[b]Now we have two completely new modes of torpedo weapons:[/b] in normal mode, torpedoes fly at the target, sometimes they miss, the radius is small, and the damage is high. In Artillery mode (enabled by the top skill in the Torpedo tree), torpedoes fly past asteroids and hit the target accurately.

Other changes:
- added new icons for different types of armor and shields, reworked existing items
- the skill "Magnetic torpedo" is replaced by the skill "Artillery mode"
- in artillery mode, the ship cannot move, but receives a bonus to attack, and torpedoes ignore obstacles
- exit from the artillery mode is possible no earlier than the recharge of the skill ends - this is 60/45 and 30 seconds for different skill levels
- changed the visual effect of "Destabilizing Explosion"
- the skill "Humanitarian aid" restores less armor than a shield
- many internal changes to cancel existing effects
- other fixes and improvements


[b]0.4.320[/b]
Changes:
- The talent "Debris search" is now passive. Once studied, the engineer can knock debris out of the asteroids in the future with this talent there will be a chance of getting some items when the enemy dies
- engineer can shoot asteroids and collect debris that are needed to build new asteroids
- building a new asteroid requires 3 pieces of debris and you need to stay in one place for 10 seconds and do not perform any other actions, cooldown of the skill is 60 seconds and they are counted from the start of the cast
- after entering the artillery mode, an effect is applied for 30/45/60 seconds, in which the cancellation of the mode leads to a slowdown by 75% for the remaining duration of the action
- artillery mode gives a 33/66/100% bonus to torpedo damage
- reworked fx of hitting the target for plasma, lasers and torpedoes in normal mode. Possible multiple bugs and misses:)
- added message errors if you can't take an item for some reason
- new color for building skills
- fixed a problem when, due to an error when using a skill, its cooldown was not visible
- other fixes and improvements

notes.title: Monthly changelog
notes.notes:
Hey pilots!
There was a lot of changes this month, some of them:

[b]Graphics:[/b]
- taking damage damage now leads to shaking camera and red flashing at the edges of the screen
- indication of low HP, stuns, silence now with flashing at the edges of the screen
- additional anti-aliasing FXAA at High and Ultra lighting settings
- activated OpenGL 4.3 mode (including 4.5+) to speed up client loading
- significant changes in the display of the point of explosion of missiles
- changed animation of torpedoes and their trail
- a lot of changes in weapon effects (FX)
- various graphics improvements

[b]Skills and Gameplay:[/b]
- added second rank to "Nanorobots" skill, which lasts 15 seconds instead of 10 and requires 11 talent points.
- "Full control" skill has been removed and moved to the "Repair" branch
- added one ot the top skills for Armor branch "Oil Cloud", aura that slows down all ships within a radius of 30 meters, and consumes 5 units of shield per second.
- skill "For wear" does not work if there are no machine guns overheated (you need at least one not overheated to work)
- reworked CTF 4x4 map, now there are passages from the Clone Station to the center of the map, closed by energie barrier that open from the inside. Opening is possible only during the battle and for 10 seconds
- added checks when buying a weapons, armor, ships, etc for presence of the necessary talents
- in the case of takeoff with a hull with missing talents, a slowdown debuff is applied
- changed the rules for the appearance of random items in trade at the station
- reduction of the effect of bonuses for long cooldown weapons starts from 2 seconds
- changes in damage and attack speed of torpedo weapons (DPS remains unchanged)
- reworked  formula for damage from shots that remove shield
- fixed "Multi stage charge" - one charge hits one target
- "Destabilizing Explosion" now deals 100 damage
- skill "Silence zone" now has a radius of 40 meters (was 30)
- maximum deceleration now 80%, except stun effects
- the laser skill "Blind" now 10 second cooldown
- Specialist hulls now visible for sale
- NPC reputation no longer affects purchases in the BG store
- "Portable Pulsar" now resets cooldowns of spells and items that have less than 30 seconds of cooldown
- the Repairman class is available for the test
- classes icons are dynamical now and show its hull type, primary and secondary specialization
- "Reload" skill now restores both shield and HP
- invulnerability, acceleration, etc skills leads to flag drop
- "shield neutralization" absorbs 50-75% of total volume of the target's shield and does not depend on the equipped weapon
- Friendly Fire is turned off for training games


[b]UI:[/b]
- if there are more than 4 active quests they are shown in a reduced mode
- fixed problem with a black screen on start
- character classes are now divided into 6 categories, instead of 3
- added item filters to shop
- changes in ships classes they are: military, armored, scout, command, scientific, special
- slot for the cloaking module is only available on the scout and special hull
- slot for the drone module is only available on the scientific and command ship
- in the combat log, different types of damage are shown in different colors (yellow - explosions, blue - energy, gray - physics)
- debuff icons are red now

- Fixed quests with a counter of more than 32768 (did not show correctly)
- fixed a situation where empty quest tasks were shown
- target selection has been redone - now you can press TAB to select any target that is visible on the minimap
- left-clicking on the cone of attack leads to the choice of target

- fixed problem with ESC and closing windows
- after entering text into the chat, it automatically collapses

[b] Build 0.4.299. Test [/b]

- lighting quality settings and option to disable new lighting at all
- broken stations on the background
- fixed bug with invisible NPCs and players
- added another map for CTF mode
- various optimizations

[b] Build 0.4.298. Graphics [/b]

Version with new background graphics and new maps. There are many possible bugs, especially with graphics. Also there could be different performance issues.

[b] Build 0.4.296 [/b]

- fixed problem with disappearing effect icons on characters name plates
- added visual effect for the acceleration bonus
- fixes for the correct removal of visual effects in space
- maximum zoom out by default upon entering the world
- spin effect is implemented - the target rotates and cannot control it
- talent 'Destabilizing blast' is now active, rather than passive, deals critical damage and stops the enemy
- talent 'Humanitarian aid' restores both the shield and the target’s hull points, can be used on friends

notes.title: Client update
notes.notes:
Today we have two updates in a row. First of all we have new music from Jesse Gallagher and also all team members on CTF games now have distinctive blue and red marks!

Version 0.4.294:

- fixed bug with invisible missiles
- fixed GameObjectError when putting down the flag
- Flurry of Fire talent launches 4 missiles instead of 6
- changed and significantly accelerated the rendering of stars and the sun
- additional price balancing
- the character retains its orientation upon resurrection
- some resurrection and death tweaks
- new non-intrusive soundtrack
- sounds and music are loaded in parallel (removes jerks when the sound first appears)
- other changes and improvements

Version 0.4.295:

- fixed a problem with registration and the account log in issues
- the skill Breakthrough makes a volley of 10/20 missiles instead of 12/24 as before
- possession of an artifact gives -30% to speed (there was a bug in build 294 that gave +25% instead of -25%)
- fixed a bug in the English locale when it was stated incorrectly which team lost the flag
- changed some workings with flags in Russian locale
- torpedo talents reviewed, optimized and are now in RC state for next builds
- replaced artifact icon while carrying it
- added player team icon for all CTF battles
- the Fast and the Furious skill reduces maneuverability not by 100%, but by 80%. Ship control is now allowed during the skill effect
- added another soundtrack, music will now be repeated
- highlight the artifact when it is lying on the playing field
- different colors for effect icons at the character’s life strip
- no BG bots with stun effects are created
- minor price changes
- other changes and fixes
